in_sanskrit.name: Lekhraj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Scribe of God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lekhraj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Lekhraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'lekh' meaning 'scribe' and 'Raj' meaning 'God' or 'King'. This name is given to a boy who is believed to have a divine connection or is destined to serve a higher purpose. In Hindu mythology, Lekhraj is associated with the god Brahma, who is considered the creator of the universe and the god of knowledge and learning.
